key_points: Home Depot trading near 52‑week low (~$289) and ~32% below all‑time high, reflecting pressure from higher mortgage rates and soft housing turnover.
Guidance was reaffirmed after a stronger quarter, indicating management sees no near‑term downgrade despite the stock price weakness.
Digital investments and Pro‑focused tools are cited as drivers of online growth and deeper customer engagement.
Insider selling by Rep. Kevin Hern noted, though routine disclosures carry limited signal.
Comparative analyses with Lowe’s highlight HD’s valuation relative to peers but note both face similar macro headwinds.
